'''Nagat Keris Ratua''' was a [[Zelosian]] [[First Counselor]]. He had a [[Feelah Derin|Tertiary Wife]] named [[Feelah Derin]] with which they bore a son, [[Celot Ratua Dil]], Nagat's second.
